question:

solution:
The shaded part shows that the plumbers are there who are also hairdressers and judges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6de256f033e951272b6e08bb711086bd24668843358a67940eaa25ade75b8a7e.png] 

Thus, the plumbers are there who are also hairdressers and judges is "19".
